record.body:
## Problem

No view answers "what needs me, what is running, what is next" at a glance. The plan view prints unlabeled payload values and mixes finished and live work.

## Approach

Add a `dashboard` view to the se-workflow contract. Its roles are the dashboard sections: needs-you, running, ready, waiting, recently done. Add the small runtime features the view needs in adaptive-artifacts: labeled field rendering and a recency selection.

## Exit criteria

`adaptive-artifacts view --id project:dashboard` renders every section, with labeled fields, against a seeded test store. Contract self-consistency and runtime tests pass.
record.subject: dashboard-view
